description: Defines classes and constants for DVB broadcast descriptors such as NetworkName, SatelliteDeliverySystem, CableDeliverySystem, and Service within the Thunder::Broadcast::DVB::Descriptors namespace.

classes.name: NetworkName
classes.description: Represents a network name descriptor with a method to retrieve the name string.

classes.name: SatelliteDeliverySystem
classes.description: Represents satellite delivery system descriptor with methods to access frequency, modulation, symbol rate, and FEC.

classes.name: CableDeliverySystem
classes.description: Represents cable delivery system descriptor with methods to access frequency, modulation, symbol rate, and FEC details.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a service descriptor with methods to get service type, provider, and name.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the network name as a string.

methods.name: Frequency
methods.description: Returns the frequency in KHz for satellite or cable delivery systems.

methods.name: Modulation
methods.description: Returns the modulation type for satellite or cable delivery systems.

methods.name: SymbolRate
methods.description: Returns the symbol rate for satellite or cable delivery systems.

methods.name: FECInner
methods.description: Returns the inner FEC coding for satellite or cable delivery systems.

methods.name: FECOuter
methods.description: Returns the outer FEC coding for cable delivery systems.
